words.meaning: patience is the key to relief
words.exampleMeaning: Grandmother said: patience is the key to relief.

words.example: يُشَجِّعُ الْمُعَلِّمُ طُلَّابَهُ بِقَوْلِهِ: مَنْ جَدَّ وَجَدَ.
words.exampleMeaning: The teacher encourages his students by saying: whoever strives finds success.

words.example: تَذَكَّرْ أَنَّ الْوَقْتَ كَالسَّيْفِ فَلَا تُضَيِّعْهُ.
words.exampleMeaning: Remember that time is like a sword, so do not waste it.

words.word: دِرْهَمُ وِقَايَةٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ قِنْطَارِ عِلَاجٍ
words.reading: dirhamu wiqāyatin khayrun min qinṭāri ʿilājin
words.example: يَنْصَحُ الطَّبِيبُ بِالنَّظَافَةِ، فَدِرْهَمُ وِقَايَةٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ قِنْطَارِ عِلَاجٍ.
words.exampleMeaning: The doctor advises cleanliness, because prevention is better than cure.

words.word: عُصْفُورٌ فِي الْيَدِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ عَلَى الشَّجَرَةِ
words.reading: ʿuṣfūrun fī l-yadi khayrun min ʿasharatin ʿalā sh-shajarati
words.meaning: a bird in the hand is worth ten in the tree
words.example: اِقْبَلِ الْفُرْصَةَ الْحَاضِرَةَ؛ عُصْفُورٌ فِي الْيَدِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ عَلَى الشَّجَرَةِ.
words.exampleMeaning: Accept the present opportunity; a bird in the hand is worth ten in the tree.

words.example: أَخْطَأَ الْخَبِيرُ مَرَّةً، وَلِكُلِّ جَوَادٍ كَبْوَةٌ.
words.exampleMeaning: The expert made a mistake once, and every noble horse stumbles.

words.word: لَا يُلْدَغُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مِنْ جُحْرٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ
words.reading: lā yuldaghu l-muʾminu min juḥrin marratayni
words.meaning: a believer is not stung from the same hole twice
words.example: تَعَلَّمْ مِنْ خَطَئِكَ؛ لَا يُلْدَغُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مِنْ جُحْرٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ.
words.exampleMeaning: Learn from your mistake; a believer is not stung from the same hole twice.

words.word: عَلَى قَدْرِ أَهْلِ الْعَزْمِ تَأْتِي الْعَزَائِمُ
words.reading: ʿalā qadri ʾahli l-ʿazmi taʾtī l-ʿazāʾimu
words.example: قَرَأْنَا بَيْتًا مَشْهُورًا: عَلَى قَدْرِ أَهْلِ الْعَزْمِ تَأْتِي الْعَزَائِمُ.
words.exampleMeaning: We read a famous verse: great resolve brings great deeds.

words.meaning: a harmful thing may bring benefit
words.example: تَأَخَّرَ السَّفَرُ، وَلٰكِنْ رُبَّ ضَارَّةٍ نَافِعَةٌ.
words.exampleMeaning: The trip was delayed, but a harmful thing may bring benefit.

words.meaning: the monkey is a gazelle in its mother's eye
words.example: تَضْحَكُ الْأُمُّ وَتَقُولُ: الْقِرْدُ فِي عَيْنِ أُمِّهِ غَزَالٌ.
words.exampleMeaning: The mother laughs and says: the monkey is a gazelle in its mother's eye.

words.example: نَحْتَاجُ إِلَى التَّعَاوُنِ؛ يَدٌ وَاحِدَةٌ لَا تُصَفِّقُ.
words.exampleMeaning: We need cooperation; one hand does not clap.

words.meaning: not all that glitters is gold
words.example: تَحَقَّقْ مِنَ الْعَرْضِ؛ مَا كُلُّ مَا يَلْمَعُ ذَهَبًا.
words.exampleMeaning: Check the offer; not all that glitters is gold.

words.meaning: knowledge is light and ignorance is darkness
words.example: تُؤْمِنُ الْمَدْرَسَةُ بِأَنَّ الْعِلْمَ نُورٌ وَالْجَهْلَ ظَلَامٌ.
words.exampleMeaning: The school believes that knowledge is light and ignorance is darkness.

words.meaning: the best speech is brief and meaningful
words.example: اُكْتُبْ جُمْلَةً قَصِيرَةً؛ خَيْرُ الْكَلَامِ مَا قَلَّ وَدَلَّ.
words.exampleMeaning: Write a short sentence; the best speech is brief and meaningful.

words.meaning: when wisdom is complete, speech becomes less
words.example: يَتَكَلَّمُ الْحَكِيمُ قَلِيلًا؛ إِذَا تَمَّ الْعَقْلُ نَقَصَ الْكَلَامُ.
words.exampleMeaning: The wise person speaks little; when wisdom is complete, speech becomes less.

words.meaning: the caravan moves on while dogs bark
words.example: لَا تَنْشَغِلْ بِالنَّقْدِ الظَّالِمِ؛ الْقَافِلَةُ تَسِيرُ وَالْكِلَابُ تَنْبَحُ.
words.exampleMeaning: Do not be distracted by unfair criticism; the caravan moves on while dogs bark.

items.question: What does ‘الصَّبْرُ مِفْتَاحُ الْفَرَجِ’ mean?
options: patience is the key to relief
a bird in the hand is worth ten in the tree

items.question: What does ‘مَنْ جَدَّ وَجَدَ’ mean?
options: a bird in the hand is worth ten in the tree

items.question: What does ‘الْوَقْتُ كَالسَّيْفِ’ mean?
options: a believer is not stung from the same hole twice
